title: Distress Signal
description: Compare and sort nested list packets to decode a distress signal.
writeup:
## Approach

Packets are nested lists of integers — conveniently valid JSON, so `json.loads` handles parsing. Comparison follows specific rules: integers compare directly, lists compare element-by-element (shorter list wins ties), and mixed types promote the integer to a single-element list.

## Part 1

For each pair, check if the left packet is less than the right. Sum the 1-based indices of correctly ordered pairs.

## Part 2

Combine all packets, add divider packets `[[2]]` and `[[6]]`, sort using the comparison function, and multiply the 1-based positions of the two dividers to get the decoder key.
